blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Remote sensing increasingly captures the Earth's surface through complementary sensors such as SAR and optical, yet ground-truth annotations remain scarce, limiting supervised approaches. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses the label scarcity, and cross-modal SSL further exploits the complementarity between co-located sensors, but existing cross-modal frameworks align modalities mostly through global image-level representations or treat them as largely redundant, leaving their fine-grained complementary structure underexploited. We propose CroCoMAE, a cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical remote sensing that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling within a ViT-based architecture, operating at two complementary levels. At the image level, an intra-modality contrastive loss on the class token yields globally discriminative, augmentation-invariant representations. At the patch level, masked image modeling drives fine-grained per-modality representations, while a cross-modal contrastive objective aligns a shared subspace across SAR and optical patch tokens, leaving the complementary subspace unconstrained to retain modality-specific information. On two SAR-optical benchmarks covering scene classification and semantic segmentation, CroCoMAE improves over uni-modal SSL baselines and outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal frameworks in most configurations, with gains in both single-modality and multi-modal evaluation across varying label regimes and the largest improvements on semantic segmentation.
blocks.zh: 遥感越来越多地通过合成孔径雷达和光学等辅助传感器来捕捉地表,但地面真实情况说明仍然很少,限制了监督方法。 自我监督的学习(SSL)解决了标签的稀缺性,而跨模式的SSL进一步利用了同地传感器之间的互补性,但现有的跨模式框架主要通过全球图像层面的表示来调整模式,或者将其视为基本上是多余的,使得其精细的互补结构未得到充分利用. 我们提议采用CroCoMAE这一合成孔径雷达遥感的跨模式SSL框架,在以紫外线为基础的结构内统一对比性学习和蒙面图像模型,在两个相辅相成的层面上运作。 在图像层面,类标志上的模式内对比性损失产生全球歧视性、增殖性-变化性的表现。 在补丁层面,被遮盖的图像模型驱动着精细的每模式表示,而跨模式对比性目标则将共享的子空间对接到整个SAR和光学补丁符上,使得互补的子空间不受限制地保留模式特定信息. 在涵盖场景分类和语义分解的两个SAR-光学基准上,CroCoMAE改进了单式SSL基线,并在大多数配置中超越了最先进的交叉模式框架,在单式和多式评价方面都取得了不同标签制度的收益,在语义分解方面的改进最大。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Remote Sensing (RS) is increasingly characterized by the availability of multi-modal sensor data, with multiple satellites and sensors acquiring complementary information over the same region of interest [ yuan2025survey ] ; SAR and optical sensors are a prime example, complementary in availability as well as information, as SAR operates through cloud and darkness where optical fails. Yet, while the volume of raw multi-sensor RS data grows exponentially, ground truth annotations remain scarce and costly to obtain [ roscher2024better ] , precluding the adoption of standard supervised approaches for RS downstream tasks. Self-supervised learning (SSL) mitigates this imbalance by exploiting abundant unlabeled RS data [ chen2025self ] . Existing SSL methods for a single modality broadly fall into two families with complementary strengths: contrastive/distance-based approaches [ Chen2020 , Zbontar2021 ] , which contrast augmented views to learn globally discriminative representations but capture little fine-grained spatial structure, and reconstruction/generative approaches [ He2022 , Bachmann2022 ] , which recover masked input to learn local structure but yield less globally discriminative features. Both are well studied uni-modally in computer vision [ gui2024survey ] and RS [ tao2023self ] , yet applied to a single modality they cannot exploit the complementarity between co-located sensors. Cross-modal SSL targets this, but existing approaches [ Dufumier2025 , Wang2024 , fuller2023croma ] align the two modalities only through global image-level representations, even when cross-modal contrast is combined with masked reconstruction [ fuller2023croma ] , leaving fine-grained, patch-level cross-modal alignment underexplored (Sec. II ). To close this gap, in the context of SAR-optical RS data, we propose CroCoMAE ( Cro ss-modal self-supervised Co llaborative M asked A uto E ncoder), a ViT-based framework that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling at two complementary levels. At the image level, a within-modality contrastive loss on the class token enforces globally discriminative representations. At the patch level, masked image modeling drives per-modality fine-grained reconstruction, while a cross-modal contrastive term aligns a shared subspace across SAR and optical patch tokens, leaving the unshared subspace free to capture complementary, possibly modality-specific information. Unlike prior work that aligns only global representations, this patch-level objective lets CroCoMAE exploit fine-grained SAR-optical interactions. We evaluate CroCoMAE on two SAR-optical benchmarks covering scene classification and semantic segmentation. Compared to uni-modal SSL baselines and cross-modal frameworks, across varying label regimes and under both linear probing and full fine-tuning, CroCoMAE consistently provides an effective general-purpose initialization.
blocks.zh: 遥感的特征日益突出,即提供多式传感器数据,多颗卫星和传感器在同一感兴趣的地区获取补充信息[人民币2025元调查];搜索和救援和光学传感器是主要的范例,既能提供又能提供信息,因为搜索和救援在光学失灵时通过云和黑暗进行。 然而,虽然原始多传感器的RS数据量呈指数增长,但地面真相说明仍然很少,而且获得[roscher2024better]的费用高昂,因此无法为塞族共和国下游任务采用标准监督方法。 自我监督的学习(SSL)通过利用丰富的无标签的RS数据[chen2025self]来缓解这种不平衡. 一种单一模式的现有SSL方法大致属于两个具有互补优势的家庭:对比性/基于距离的方法[Chen2020,Zbontar2021],形成对比的是扩大观点以学习全球歧视表述,但捕捉到很少精细的空间结构,以及重建/再生方法[He2022,Bachmann2022],这些方法恢复了蒙蔽的输入来学习地方结构,但产生较少的全球歧视特征. 两者在计算机视觉[gui2024 survey]和RS[tao2023self]中都经过了很好的单式研究,然而它们却无法利用同地传感器之间的互补性。 跨模式SSL以此为目标,但现有方法[Dufumier2025,Wang2024,更充分2023croma]仅通过全球图像级别表示来调整两种模式,即使跨模式对比与被蒙蔽的重建相结合[更充分2023croma],留下了细纹的,补丁级的跨模式对接不足探索(Sec. II). 为了缩小这一差距,在SAR-光学RS数据方面,我们提议采用CroCoMAE(Cro s-module自控Co laborative M ask A uto E ncoder),这是一种基于ViT的框架,在两个互补层面统一了对比性学习和蒙面图像模型. 在形象方面,类标志上的一种模式内对比性损失使全球的歧视性表述成为现实。 在补丁层面,被遮蔽的图像模型驱动着每条模式的精细纹理重建,而交叉模式对比名词则将一个共享的子空间对接到整个SAR和光学补丁符上,使得未共享的子空间可以自由获取互补的,可能是模式特定的信息. 与以前只协调全球代表的工作不同,这个补丁级目标让克罗科MAE利用精细的合成孔径雷达-光学相互作用. 我们评价CroCoMAE的两个SAR-光学基准,包括场景分类和语义分解. 与单式SSL基线和跨模式框架相比,在各种标签制度下,在线性测试和全面微调下,CroCoMAE一贯提供有效的通用初始化。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: i) CroCoMAE , a cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical RS data unifying contrastive learning and masked image modeling at image and patch levels; ii) A patch-level cross-modal contrastive design that aligns a shared subspace across modalities while leaving the unshared subspace free to capture complementary, possibly modality-specific information, enabling fine-grained SAR-optical collaboration beyond global alignment; iii) An extensive evaluation on scene classification and semantic segmentation benchmarks against uni-modal and cross-modal SSL frameworks retrained under the same controlled protocol, showing gains in most configurations across low-data label regimes, particularly on dense prediction.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是:(一) CroCoMAE,一个用于SAR-光学RS数据的跨模式SSL框架,在图像和补丁层面统一对比性学习和蒙面图像模型;(二) 补丁级跨模式对比性设计,将共享的子空间与模式相配合,同时让未共享子空间自由获取互补的、可能与模式相适应的信息,使精细的SAR-光学合作超越了全球对齐;(三) 对场地分类和语义分解基准进行广泛的评价,参照单一模式和跨模式SSL框架,在同一受控协议下重新进行了培训,显示大多数配置在低数据标签制度中取得了收益,特别是在密集预测方面。

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Uni-Modal Self-Supervised. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a paradigm for learning representations from unlabeled data, eliminating the need for large amounts of costly annotations. Contrastive/distance-based approaches became dominant, with frameworks such as SimCLR [ Chen2020 ] , MoCo [ He2020 ] and BYOL [ Grill2020 ] , and dense variants such as DenseCL [ wang2021densecl ] , maximizing agreement between augmented views of the same image. Redundancy-reduction methods, notably Barlow Twins [ Zbontar2021 ] and VICReg [ Bardes2022 ] , instead decorrelate feature dimensions to avoid collapse without explicit negative pairs. More recently, masked image modeling regained prominence through Masked Autoencoders (MAE) [ He2022 ] , showing that reconstruction alone yields rich, transferable representations. Such techniques have been widely adopted in RS: for optical data, e.g., SatMAE [ Cong2022 ] and SpectralGPT [ Hong2024 ] , adapting contrastive or masked modeling to multispectral and multi-temporal imagery; and, only very recently, for SAR data, e.g. SARMAE [ liu2026sarmae ] .

blocks.en: Multi-Modal Self-Supervised. A natural extension of Uni-Modal SSL consists in training a single unified model across modalities or sensors. This has led to large multi-modal foundation models, e.g., ImageBind [ Girdhar2023 ] , which anchors six modalities to a shared image embedding space, and MultiMAE [ Bachmann2022 ] , which extends masked autoencoding to multi-modal, multi-task reconstruction. At larger scale, several works introduce RS foundation models pretrained on massive external multi-sensor corpora, including SMARTIES [ sumbul2025smarties ] , TERRAMIND [ jakubik2025terramind ] and AnySat [ astruc2025anysat ] . These works target general-purpose pretraining at a scale not directly comparable to the controlled comparison adopted here. Regardless of scale, these approaches learn a common representation across modalities, conflating shared and modality-specific features. This motivates a complementary line of work, discussed next, that instead uses dedicated per-modality encoders with explicit cross-modal alignment, allowing shared and specific information to be represented separately rather than fused. Cross-Modal Self-Supervised. Purely contrastive cross-modal approaches implicitly assume multiview redundancy: all task-relevant information is shared across modalities, an assumption often violated in practice. CoMM [ Dufumier2025 ] addresses this via a contrastive objective in a fused multimodal space, showing empirically that purely cross-modal methods fail to capture unique and synergistic information. DeCUR [ Wang2024 ] partitions each per-modality encoder’s embedding into a common subspace, aligned via Barlow Twins loss, and a unique subspace, explicitly decorrelated across modalities. CROMA [ fuller2023croma ] combines both paradigms: it performs cross-modal contrastive learning on global, average-pooled unimodal representations of masked inputs, with no explicit decomposition, while a separate cross-modal encoder fuses both modalities to jointly reconstruct their masked patches. DeCUR has been evaluated under in-domain training in its original work, whereas CROMA was pretrained on a large external multi-sensor corpus; since its objectives do not depend on the pretraining corpus, we retrain both methods in-domain under the same controlled protocol as CroCoMAE (Sec. IV ). Our work follows a subspace decomposition principle like DeCUR , but differs from all three methods: rather than operating only on global image-level embeddings, CroCoMAE acts also at the level of spatially localised ViT patch tokens within a masked autoencoding framework, leveraging cross-modal contrastive alignment directly within a shared subspace, while reconstruction remains per-modality and independent. This yields a shared/unshared decomposition expressed directly at the patch level, which distinguishes CroCoMAE from prior cross-modal SSL frameworks. Table I summarizes the design differences across the discussed approaches.

blocks.en: CroCoMAE is built on the Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture and combines masked autoencoding with contrastive learning at two complementary levels of representation. At the image level, the CLS token is trained with an intra-modal contrastive loss to produce globally discriminative, augmentation-invariant representations. At the patch level, the embedding of each per-modality encoder is split into a shared subspace, aligned across sensors, and an unshared subspace, left free to retain complementary, possibly modality-specific information. Unlike prior cross-modal approaches that decompose global image representations, CroCoMAE applies this decomposition to spatially localised patch tokens, enabling fine-grained cross-modal collaboration, while masked reconstruction grounds each encoder in within-modality structure. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , each encoder processes three inputs per image: the original image and an augmented view, whose CLS tokens feed the image-level loss, and a masked version, whose visible patch tokens feed the patch-level losses. The two sets of tokens are thus used by mutually exclusive objectives, which nonetheless act on the same encoder weights, updated jointly in a single training stage.
blocks.zh: CroCoMAE建于视觉变形器(ViT)架构上,并在两个互补的代表层次上将蒙面自编码与对比性学习相结合. 在图像方面,CLS标志的培训带有模式内对比性损失,以产生全球歧视性、增强-变化性的表现。 在补丁层面,每个通式编码器的嵌入被分割成一个共享的子空间,在传感器之间对齐,和一个未共享的子空间,可以自由保留互补的,可能是模式特定的信息. 与之前分解全球图像表示的跨模式方法不同,CroCoMAE将这种分解应用于空间定位的补丁符号上,使得有精细纹饰的跨模式协作成为可能,而被遮盖的重建则将每个编码器都置于模式内结构中. 如图一所示,每个编码器处理每个图像的3个输入:原始的图像和被放大的视图,其CLS的活符会为图像级别损失提供素材,并有一个被遮蔽的版本,其可见的补丁活符会为补丁级别损失提供素材. 因此,这两套符号被相互排斥的目标所使用,尽管如此,它们还是以同样的编码器重量作为行动,在一个单一的培训阶段共同更新。

blocks.en: IV Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 四. 实验评价

blocks.en: To evaluate CroCoMAE , we design an experimental study covering two SAR-optical RS benchmarks, for scene classification and semantic segmentation. We compare against both standard uni-modal SSL methods and recent cross-modal approaches. We conduct an ablation study where the contribution of each component of CroCoMAE is assessed, explore the interplay between CLS and patch tokens, and analyse the behaviour of CroCoMAE varying the size of the shared subspace. Finally, we provide a visual inspection of the segmentation maps produced by CroCoMAE and representative competing approaches and a discussion on computational costs.
blocks.zh: 为了评价CroCoMAE,我们设计了一项实验研究,涵盖两个SAR-光学RS基准,用于场景分类和语义分解. 我们比较了标准单式SSL方法和最近的交叉式方法。 我们进行了一项消化研究,其中评估了CroCoMAE每个组件的贡献,探索了CLS和补丁符之间的相互作用,并分析了CroCoMAE改变共享子空间大小的行为. 最后,我们对CroCoMAE制作的分区图和有代表性的相互竞争的方法进行目视检查,并讨论计算费用。

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate CroCoMAE on two downstream tasks. In both cases, Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multi-spectral optical (Opt) images are used, with SAR images providing two polarization channels and multi-spectral optical images providing 13 spectral bands. EuroSAT-SAR [ Wang2024a ] (Multi-Class Classification): A SAR extension of the original EuroSAT dataset [ Helber2019 ] , constructed by matching each Sentinel-2 patch with a co-registered Sentinel-1 patch based on geospatial coordinates. The resulting dataset comprises 27,000 SAR-Opt image pairs spanning 10 land-cover classes, with 2,700 samples per class. Each image is 64 × \times 64 pixels. DFC2020 [ Robinson2021 ] (Semantic Segmentation): Derived from SEN12MS [ Schmitt2019 ] and released as part of the 2020 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest for weakly supervised semantic segmentation, this dataset provides SAR-Opt image pairs with annotations at two resolutions. We consider the publicly available training and validation sets. From the training set we derive 97,824 SAR-Opt image pairs by tiling the original 256 × 256 256\times 256 patches into non-overlapping 64 × 64 64\times 64 sub-patches; since the corresponding annotations are at coarse resolution (500m × \times 500m), they are discarded. The validation set comprises 15,776 image pairs with high-resolution annotations spanning 9 land-cover classes.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价CroCoMAE的两个下游任务. 在这两种情况下,均使用Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2多光谱光学(Opt)图像,而SAR图像提供两个分化通道,多光谱光学图像提供13个光谱波段. blocks.en:
Competing Approaches. We compare CroCoMAE against several competitors spanning both uni-modal and cross-modal SSL strategies. On the uni-modal side, we consider three well-established approaches: SimCLR [ Chen2020 ] , Barlow Twins [ Zbontar2021 ] , and Masked AutoEncoder ( MAE ) [ He2022 ] . On the cross-modal side, we consider two state-of-the-art approaches designed for and evaluated on SAR-optical RS data: Decoupling Common and Unique Representations ( DeCUR ) [ Wang2024 ] and Contrastive Radar-Optical Masked Autoencoders ( CROMA ) [ fuller2023croma ] , all retrained in-domain under the same controlled protocol, following the original available implementations and recommendations, adapted to the shared ViT-Small backbone.
We further include SimCLR-C and Barlow Twins-C [ Wang2024 ] , which extend their respective uni-modal counterparts to the cross-modal setting by treating the corresponding image from the other modality (SAR or Opt) as an augmentation of the input.
We additionally include CroCoMAE NoU as an internal variant of our framework, in which the ℒ shd \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{shd}} loss is applied directly to the full patch embedding, without partitioning it into shared and unshared subspaces. For all SSL methods we use a ViT-Small backbone [ touvron2021training ] . We additionally report two supervised baselines using ViT-Small and ResNet-50. For the multi-class classification task ( EuroSAT-SAR ), all backbones are combined with a single-layer classifier. For semantic segmentation ( DFC2020 ), all ViT-based backbones are paired with a lightweight PSPNet-style pyramid pooling head [ zhao2017pyramid ] applied to the final-layer patch tokens, while ResNet-50 is used within a UNet [ Ronneberger_2015_MICCAI ] architecture baseline.

Experimental Settings. All SSL approaches share the same data, backbone and fine-tuning setup, and are pre-trained with AdamW [ Loshchilov2019 ] (weight decay 0.05) for 260,000 steps (batch size 512), with a maximum learning rate of 1.5 × 10 − 4 1.5\times 10^{-4} , a linear warm-up of 20 epochs, followed by cosine annealing with warm restarts.
We evaluate single-modal (SAR, Opt) and multi-modal (MM) settings, the latter obtained by concatenating per-modality embeddings before the classification head. Fine-tuning uses two labeled regimes (1% / 10% of data, with the remaining 99% / 90% held out for testing) under two strategies: Linear Probing (LP, frozen encoder) and Full Fine-Tuning (Full-FT, all weights updated), for 300 epochs with batch size 64. For DFC2020 , LP denotes a frozen encoder with a trainable segmentation head.

We follow standard SSL augmentations [ Grill2020 ] adapted to multi-channel inputs (resized crop with scale 0.2–1, horizontal/vertical flip, Gaussian blur, brightness/contrast jitter, and a grayscale conversion replacing all channels with their mean, applicable to any number of bands), and a masking ratio r = 75 % r=75\% for all MAE-based methods [ He2022 ] . Encoders use 8 × 8 8\times 8 -pixel patches; the per-modality decoders of CroCoMAE have 2 layers (128-d, 8 heads),
and the CLS projection head, discarded after pre-training, is a two-layer MLP (512–128). For contrastive objectives, we use a single temperature τ = 1 \tau=1 for all methods, to avoid per-method tuning, except for CROMA , whose temperature is learnable (initialised at 0.07) as in its original design. Following [ Wang2024 ] , we use the ViT class token for classification heads and patch tokens for segmentation; CROMA , which has no class token in its original design, is evaluated with average-pooled patch tokens for classification. Performance is measured via weighted F1 on EuroSAT-SAR and mIoU on DFC2020 , averaged over five runs. Using a protocol identical across methods, for EuroSAT-SAR we adopt a transductive setup where pre-training and fine-tuning share the same images (labels used only during fine-tuning); for DFC2020 , we pre-train on the training split and fine-tune/evaluate on the disjoint validation split. This inductive protocol, in which evaluation images are never seen during pre-training, complements the transductive EuroSAT-SAR setting.
Experiments run on an HPC facility with NVIDIA H100 SXM5 GPUs (80 GB HBM3).

blocks.en: Table II and Table III report the results on the EuroSAT-SAR and DFC2020 benchmarks, respectively. Standard deviations over the 5 runs are generally below 1.5 points at 1% labels and below 0.5 at 10%; the gains of CroCoMAE over the strongest competitors exceed one standard deviation in most configurations. Overall, CroCoMAE achieves the best performance in the majority of the configurations, demonstrating its effectiveness and generality. Across benchmarks and label regimes, CroCoMAE ’s Linear Probing performance closely matches Full Fine-Tuning, showing that the pretrained representations are already effective without costly task-specific adaptation. In contrast, several competing methods, most notably Barlow Twins on EuroSAT-SAR and DeCUR on DFC2020 , exhibit substantially larger LP/Full-FT discrepancies, indicating that their representations require more extensive fine-tuning to become useful for downstream tasks. This property is particularly valuable in low-data regimes, where the cost of fine-tuning itself may be a practical constraint.

blocks.en: On EuroSAT-SAR , CroCoMAE consistently surpasses all supervised baselines, with gains ranging from about 4 points (Opt, 10% labels) to about 20 points (MM, 1% labels). Among competing SSL approaches, SimCLR-C and Barlow Twins-C achieve the highest SAR LP scores at 1% labels (82.4% and 82.5%, respectively). However, this performance on the SAR modality comes at the cost of a marked degradation on the optical modality (84.6% and 83.2% vs. 96.5% for CroCoMAE ), a trend that is even more pronounced for CROMA (73.1% Opt LP, the lowest among cross-modal methods). This suggests that cross-modal strategies aligning the entire global representation tend to favour the lower-performing modality (SAR) at the expense of the higher-performing one (optical), on this benchmark. CroCoMAE avoids this imbalance through its within-modality objectives and consistently achieves the best results in the multi-modal evaluation setting.
blocks.zh: 在EuroSAT-SAR中,CroCoMAE始终超越所有受监督的基线,收益从大约4分(Opt,10%的标签)到大约20分(MM,1%的标签)不等. 在相互竞争的SSL方法中,SimCLR-C和Barlow Twins-C分别以1%的标签(分别为82.4%和82.5%)达到SAR LP最高分. 然而,这种合成孔径雷达模式的性能是以光学模式明显退化(CroCoMAE为84.6%和83.2%对96.5%)为代价的,CROMA的趋势更为明显(Opt LP为73.1%,是跨模式方法中最低的)。 这表明,调整整个全球代表性的跨模式战略倾向于偏好业绩较低的模式,而牺牲业绩较高的模式(光学)。 CroCoMAE通过其内部模式目标避免了这种不平衡,并始终如一地在多式联运评价环境中取得最佳结果。

blocks.en: DFC2020 provides an informative assessment of the quality of the fine-grained spatial representations produced by the proposed pre-training strategy. CroCoMAE is the only strategy that consistently outperforms the supervised baselines across all considered configurations. Notably, this holds even under LP, where encoder weights are frozen: at 10% labels, CroCoMAE reaches 58.1% mIoU on the SAR modality and 68.4% mIoU in the multi-modal setting, exceeding the supervised ViT baseline (32.9% and 68.2%, respectively). The obtained results highlight that CroCoMAE ’s patch-level representation learning design, which couples intra-modal masked image modeling and patch-level cross-modal alignment, appears well adapted for tasks such as semantic segmentation.

blocks.en: To investigate the contribution of the explicit subspace partitioning, we compare CroCoMAE against its ablated variant CroCoMAE NoU , which applies the cross-modal contrastive loss over the full patch embedding. On EuroSAT-SAR , CroCoMAE matches or outperforms CroCoMAE NoU in most configurations, with the largest gains at 1% labels (e.g. +4.9 for SAR under LP and +4.4 for MM under Full-FT), while at 10% labels the two variants mostly fall within a narrow margin. On DFC2020 , where patch tokens are directly exploited for dense prediction, CroCoMAE outperforms CroCoMAE NoU across both label regimes and all modalities, with the clearest margins under linear probing (+1.7 to +3.4 mIoU). This provides evidence that explicitly structuring the ViT patch-level embedding into shared/unshared subspaces benefits fine-grained spatial discrimination.
blocks.zh: 为了调查清晰的子空间分划的贡献,我们比较了CroCoMAE与其被平分的变体CroCoMAE NoU,该变体将跨模式的对比性损失应用到全补丁嵌入上. 在EuroSAT-SAR上,CroCoMAE在大多数配置中与CroCoMAE NoU相匹配或优于其性能,最大收益为1%的标签(如LP下SAR为+4.9,而Full-FT下MM为+4.4),而以10%的标签,两个变体大多属于狭长的边际. 在 DFC2020 上,直接利用补丁符号进行密集预测,CroCoMAE在标签制度和所有模式上都超越了CroCoMAE NoU,线性检测下最清晰的边距(+1.7至+3.4 mIoU). 这提供了证据表明,明确将ViT补丁层嵌入共享/未共享子空间,有利于精细的空间区分。

blocks.en: Ablation Analysis. Combining reconstruction and contrastive objectives generally outperforms either alone (Tables II and III ), motivating a closer look at their interplay. Table IV examines the impact of each loss term on EuroSAT-SAR . The last row corresponds to CroCoMAE which achieves the highest average performance on Opt and MM (e.g., 96.5/96.0 and 96.4/95.3 at 1%), showing that all terms provide complementary empirical benefits. Ablating ℒ cls \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cls}} yields the strongest SAR performance (82.7/80.8 at 1%, 84.7/82.0 at 10%) but degrades Opt and MM, indicating ℒ cls \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cls}} is key to discriminative Opt representations, at some cost to SAR-specific discriminability. ℒ shd \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{shd}} ’s contribution is mainly visible under LP: the full model improves consistently over the configuration without ℒ shd \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{shd}} (69.5 → \to 77.1 for SAR, 96.3 → \to 96.5 for Opt at 1%), though this gap narrows under Full-FT, suggesting that, on this benchmark, ℒ shd \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{shd}} improves the quality of pretrained representations, while Full-FT is able to partially compensate for its absence. Overall, the two contrastive terms play complementary roles: ℒ cls \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cls}} for global discriminability, ℒ shd \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{shd}} for frozen-representation quality, alongside the spatial grounding from ℒ MAE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MAE}} .

blocks.en: Analysis of CLS/Patch tokens interplay. Table V reports the LP performance on EuroSAT-SAR of different token representations extracted from the frozen CroCoMAE encoders; we restrict this analysis to LP, as it directly probes the information encoded in the pretrained representations, which Full-FT would partly override. First, the pooled patch tokens are globally discriminative: they outperform the class token on SAR (81.8 vs. 77.1 at 1%, 84.6 vs. 82.7 at 10%), while the class token remains slightly better in the optical and multi-modal settings (e.g., 96.5 vs. 95.3 for Opt at 1%), indicating that the two levels emphasise different information. Their concatenation closely tracks the better of the two in every setting, without requiring a choice between them. Second, the two subspaces play distinct roles. The shared subspace yields almost identical scores for SAR and optical (80.6 vs. 80.3 at 1%, 81.9 for both at 10%), and combining the two modalities brings little gain (81.5 and 83.0 for MM), indicating that it encodes the same, cross-modally aligned information in both sensors. Its accuracy of over 80% further confirms that it captures scene content rather than positional cues. In contrast, the unshared subspace retains most of the optical discriminative power (92.1 vs. 80.3 for the shared subspace at 1%), and combining the unshared parts of both modalities clearly improves over each of them (95.1 for MM vs. 92.1 for Opt and 78.8 for SAR at 1%), showing that they capture complementary, modality-specific information; for SAR, in contrast, neither subspace dominates (80.6 vs. 78.8 at 1%, 81.9 vs. 84.3 at 10% for shared vs. unshared), suggesting that its discriminative information is spread across both. Finally, for single-modal inference the full patch embedding outperforms either subspace alone, confirming that both contribute to the learned representation. A direct measurement on the frozen encoders confirms that this complementary information is modality-specific rather than redundant: co-registered SAR and optical patches are nearly identical in the shared subspace (mean cosine similarity of 0.96 and 0.99 on DFC2020 and EuroSAT-SAR , vs. 0.00 for random pairs; linear CKA (Centered Kernel Alignment) [ kornblith2019similarity ] of 0.87 and 0.93), whereas in the unshared subspace they are no more similar than random pairs (cos. sim. of 0.01 and − - 0.01; CKA of 0.30 and 0.18).
blocks.zh: 分析 CLS/Patch 符号的相互作用. 表五汇报了EuroSAT-SAR上从被冻结的CroCoMAE编码器中提取出的不同符号表示的LP性能;我们只将这种分析限制在LP,因为它直接探测了被事先训练过的表示所编码的信息,Full-FT将部分地覆盖. 首先,集合补丁符号具有全球歧视性:它们在搜索和救援上的表现超过了类代号(81.8对77.1对1%,84.6对82.7对10%),而类代号在光学和多模式环境中仍然略为好一些(例如,对Opt来说是96.5对95.3),表明两个级别强调不同的信息. 他们的凝聚在每一个场合都密切跟踪两者的好处,而不需要他们之间的选择. 第二,两个子空间扮演不同的角色. 共享的子空间对合成孔径雷达和光学的分数几乎相同(80.6对80.3对80.3%,81.9对均为10%),将两种模式合并后收益甚微(MM为81.5和83.0),表明它编码了两个传感器中相同的、跨模式的对齐信息。 它的准确度超过80%进一步证实它捕捉到场景内容而不是位置提示. 相比之下,未共享的子空间保留了大部分光学歧视力量(92.1对共享子空间占1%),将两种模式的未共享部分合并在一起,显然比每种模式都有所改善(95.1对MM对92.1对Opt和78.8对SAR占1%),表明它们获取了互补的、特定模式的信息;而对于SAR来说,两个子空间都不占主导地位(80.6对78.8对1%,81.9对84.3对共享与未共享),这表明其歧视性信息分布在两个方面。 最后,对于单式推论,完全的补丁嵌入效果单于子空间,证实两者都有助于学到的表示。 对被冻结编码器的直接测量证实,这种补充信息是特定方式的,而不是多余的:共同登记的合成孔径雷达和光学补丁在共享子空间中几乎相同(DFC2020和EuroSAT-SAR上的平均同位素相似度为0.96和0.99,随机对等值为0.00;线性CKA(以克内尔对等)[kornblith2019同 0.87和0.93],而在未共享子空间中,它们并不比随机对更相似(0.01和−0.01的同位素;CKA为0.30和0.18)。

blocks.en: Analysis of the Shared/Unshared Subspace Partition. We investigate the sensitivity of CroCoMAE to the proportion of the patch token embedding allocated to the shared subspace, varying it from 10% to 90% in steps of 20%. Fig. 2 reports the weighted F1 score on EuroSAT-SAR and the mIoU on DFC2020 under LP with 1% labeled data, for the SAR and optical modalities. Two consistent trends emerge on both benchmarks. First, performance is largely insensitive to the partition over the 10–70% range: variations stay within about one standard deviation (at most 0.7 points on EuroSAT-SAR and 1.1 mIoU on DFC2020 ), with a slight optimum around 30% on both datasets. Second, allocating most of the embedding to the shared subspace consistently degrades performance: from 70% to 90% shared, SAR drops by about 5 points on EuroSAT-SAR (77.1 → \to 72.2) and by about 1.4 mIoU on DFC2020 (51.6 → \to 50.2), and the optical modality loses about 1.1 mIoU on DFC2020 (57.4 → \to 56.3), while the optical F1 on EuroSAT-SAR , already close to saturation ( ∼ \sim 96%), is only marginally affected. These results indicate that cross-modal alignment does not require a large shared capacity to be beneficial, whereas leaving too little capacity to the unshared subspace prevents each encoder from retaining complementary, modality-specific information; this is consistent with the advantage of CroCoMAE over CroCoMAE NoU (Tables II and III ), which corresponds to aligning the full embedding. The default 50/50 split lies within the stable regime on both benchmarks, at most 0.7 points from the best configuration, supporting it as a reasonable, dataset-agnostic choice rather than a per-benchmark optimum.
blocks.zh: 共享/未共享子空间分区分析. 我们调查CroCoMAE对分配到共享子空间的补丁符号嵌入比例的敏感度,在20%的步数中从10%到90%不等. 图2以1%的标签数据报告欧洲SAT-SAR的加权F1分和LP下的DFC2020的MIOU分,用于SAR和光学模式。 两个基准都出现了两个一致的趋势。 首先,在10-70%范围内,性能对分区基本不敏感:变化保持在一个标准偏差范围内(EuroSAT-SAR最高为0.7分,DFC2020最高为1.1 mIoU分),两个数据集的偏差略微达到30%左右。 第二,将大多数嵌入到共享子空间会不断降低性能:从70%到90%,SAR在EuroSAT-SAR(77.1 →\至72.2)上下降约5分,在DFC2020(51.6 →\至50.2)上下降约1.4 mIoU;光学模式在DFC2020(57.4 →\至56.3)上损失约1.1 mIoU;而已经接近饱和度的EuroSAT-SAR上的光学F1只受到轻微的影响。 这些结果表明,跨模式对接不需要巨大的共享能力才能受益,而将太多的能力留给未共享子空间则会使每个编码器无法保留互补的,模式特定的信息;这与CroCoMAE相对于CroCoMAE NoU(表二和表三)的优势是一致的,后者与完全嵌入一致. 默认的50/50分数在两种基准的稳定制度内,从最佳配置起最多为0.7分,作为合理、数据集不可知的选择而不是每个基准的最佳选择予以支持。

blocks.en: Qualitative assessment. Fig. 3 compares CroCoMAE , DeCUR and the supervised ViT-PPM baseline on DFC2020 under the multi-modal LP setting with 10% labeled data. Although all predictions are spatially coarse, as expected with a frozen encoder, CroCoMAE shows sharper class boundaries and better captures intra-scene heterogeneity: it separates compact Barren/Shrubland/Grassland regions (1st row), delineates Urban and Forest classes more accurately (2nd/3rd rows), and is the only method that preserves the continuous geometry of a river (4th row), suggesting that its patch-level objective encourages spatially fine-grained representations.

blocks.en: Computational Cost. We restrict this comparison to the cross-modal frameworks DeCUR and CROMA , excluding uni-modal-extended baselines. Both share CroCoMAE ’s two-encoder, ViT-Small-per-modality architecture, totaling approximately 43M parameters per method; the shared/unshared partition in CroCoMAE introduces no additional parameters. The only overhead specific to CroCoMAE comes from its two lightweight per-modality decoders (1.2M parameters, ∼ \sim 3% of the backbone), whereas CROMA ’s cross-modal fusion encoder and joint decoder add ∼ \sim 18M parameters; in both cases these modules are discarded after pre-training and add no cost at fine-tuning or inference. On DFC2020 , pre-training takes 34 GPU-hours for CroCoMAE and 32 for DeCUR , a similar trend is observed on EuroSAT-SAR . CROMA is cheaper (10 GPU-hours), since its contrastive and reconstruction objectives share a single forward pass on masked inputs; the additional cost of CroCoMAE comes from the full-image forward passes required by ℒ cls \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cls}} and from the dense patch-level contrast of ℒ shd \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{shd}} , the components that drive its gains on dense prediction.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented CroCoMAE , a novel cross-modal SSL framework for SAR-optical RS data that unifies contrastive learning and masked image modeling, operating at two complementary levels: image and patch. At the patch level, the per-modality embedding is split into a shared subspace, aligned across sensors, and an unshared subspace, left free to retain complementary, possibly modality-specific information. Across scene classification and semantic segmentation benchmarks, CroCoMAE achieves the strongest overall performance across low-data label regimes, training strategies and sensor-availability configurations, with the largest gains on dense prediction tasks. Future work includes extending CroCoMAE to non-RS modality pairs (e.g., RGB-Depth/Thermal) and exploring principled mechanisms for effectively combining image- and patch-level representations.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了CroCoMAE,这是用于SAR-光学RS数据的新型跨模式SSL框架,它统一了对比性学习和蒙面图像模型,在两个互补层面运作:图像和补丁。 在补丁层面,偶联嵌入被分为一个共享子空间,在传感器之间对齐,以及一个未共享子空间,可以自由保留互补的,可能是模式特定的信息. 在整个场景分类和语义分解基准中,CroCoMAE在低数据标签制度,培训策略和传感器可用性配置方面实现了最强的整体性能,在密集的预测任务上收获最大. 未来的工作包括将CroCoMAE扩展至非RS模式对(如RGB-深度/热)并探索有效将图像和补丁层面的表示结合起来的原则机制.
